proof_0193.moves: Swap the two factors using commutativity of integer multiplication, then cite the companion cancellation lemma (a*b)/b = a. Two steps, both nameable.

proof_0194.moves: The inverse form of colimit.ι_pre: move the inverse of colimit.pre to the other side of the equation (comp_inv_eq) and then close with the already-known ι_pre identity. The content is one iso-cancellation plus one citation.

proof_0195.moves: Split the iff into its two directions and hand each one to an existing lemma: forward is 'a face upstairs pulls back along an injective map', backward is 'faces push forward along maps'. The only structural act is the anonymous-constructor Iff split.

proof_0196.moves: Take the already-proved statement that a cast NNRat commutes with everything and flip the order of the Commute relation. One citation plus symmetry.

proof_0197.moves: Destructure the divisibility hypothesis into an explicit witness (write the divisible term as a product) and substitute, which turns the goal into the already-known gcd identity for gcd (a*c + b) b; a symmetry orients the equation. The real work is exhibiting/eliminating the dvd witness.

proof_0198.moves: Induction on the iteration count n: the zero case is trivial and the successor case unfolds one iterate and merges the two zpow exponents. The core move is the induction itself, carried here by the equation compiler's recursor and generated body.

proof_0199.moves: Rewrite with the un-truncated toBitVec version of the mod lemma, then push the resulting BitVec.cast through the congruence so the two sides match. Almost entirely rewriting plus a cast-congruence.

proof_0200.moves: A normalization wrapper: turn the Bool-valued beq statement into a propositional equality, apply left-cancellation of BitVec addition, and close the resulting iff by reflexivity. The mathematical content is exactly the cancellation lemma; the rest is Bool/Prop transport.

proof_0201.moves: The truncating and clamping constructions agree on this input, so the statement is exactly the already-proved clamp version; the proof is a single citation.

proof_0202.moves: Conjugation of an automorphism is by definition the composite iso alpha.symm followed by f followed by alpha; apply extensionality for Aut to reduce to an equality of underlying isos, which then holds by definition. Pure unfolding behind an ext.

proof_0203.moves: An auto-generated projection lemma: the action of the coalgebra-to-over-category functor on morphisms is literally what the definition writes down, so the proof is reflexivity. No mathematical step at all.

proof_0204.moves: A projection lemma for the monoidal structure on the double-monoidal-opposite equivalence: the unit morphism eta unwraps to the identity by definition, so the proof is reflexivity.

proof_0205.moves: Rewrite with the platform-independent toBitVec version of the Int64-to-ISize lemma (sign extension), then transport the BitVec.cast through the congruence lemma so both sides agree at width 64. Rewriting plus cast bookkeeping.

proof_0206.moves: Split the iff; one direction is the known duality that limits in the opposite category give colimits, the other falls out of the existing instance. The Iff split plus the duality lemma is the whole proof.

proof_0207.moves: Projection lemma for the constructor of an iso in the category of frames built from an order iso: the hom component is by construction the underlying order map, so reflexivity closes it.

proof_0208.moves: Use that on the integers a < b is definitionally a + 1 <= b, so the strict version of 'below the min iff below both' is exactly the non-strict lemma applied at a + 1. The successor shift is the whole idea.

proof_0209.moves: A norm_num extension step: destructure the two IsNat hypotheses so both arguments become literal natural casts, then use that the cast from Nat to Ordinal is multiplicative, and repackage as IsNat of the product.

proof_0210.moves: The reassociated form of coprod.inl_fst: whisker the base equation on the right by an arbitrary morphism and renormalize with associativity and the identity laws. Mechanically derived, so the whiskering and the category axioms are the content.

proof_0211.moves: Whiskering a simplicial object by a functor acts on the face maps componentwise by definition, so the stated equality is reflexivity. Pure unfolding.

proof_0212.moves: The underlying natural transformation of the identity morphism of a lax monoidal functor is the identity of the underlying functor, true by construction of the category instance; reflexivity.

proof_0213.moves: Specialize the general statement about arbitrary colimit cocones in Type to the chosen colimit cocone: every element of the colimit is in the image of some component map. A single application.

proof_0214.moves: Projection lemma: the counit iso of the equivalence of discrete categories induced by an equivalence of types is the one written in the definition, so reflexivity closes it.

proof_0215.moves: Projection lemma: the second homotopy component of the negated/symmetric homotopy is the stated one by construction, so the proof is reflexivity.

proof_0216.moves: The universal map out of a direct limit of rings, precomposed with the canonical map from a stage, is the given compatible family at that stage - true by how lift is defined on the quotient, so reflexivity.
